0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 0-2 at home, 1-0 on the road) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 1-0 at home) for the Magic's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Orlando 10th in the East and Toronto 4th in the East and 0.5 games back of the Atlantic lead. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Jalen Suggs is day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Kawhi Leonard is day-to-day with knee inflammation and is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Magic lost the season series 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
